BJP Announces New National Team with Key Appointments and Changes

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has announced its new national team of office-bearers, appointed by party chief Nitin Nabin. The reshuffled team includes experienced leaders and new faces, with a focus on preparation for upcoming elections. Notable inclusions are the return of Smriti Irani and Ram Madhav, while Piyush Goyal retained his position as treasurer. The new team composition has also seen a significant representation from Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh.
